motion_model.summary: Reframe (camera moves, scene unchanged) -> ken-burns (camera) or live-still (subject), NEVER morph. Transform (scene becomes something else) -> morph, only from a shared base and only between a few large flat shapes.

techniques.ken-burns: (Family A) Camera move (push/pan/tilt/drift) on a single still. Deterministic, rendered locally via tools/ai-video/render_kenburns.py. Zero AI risk. Needs resolution headroom (source >= output x zoom) — upscale to stills-4k/ first via tools/ai-video/upscale.py.
techniques.cinemagraph: (Family B) Masked ambient motion — one element (smoke, flare, glow, water, flag) animates while the rest holds. Pika masked or NLE. Low risk: mask-defined, not depth. Never leave reflective water/flicker unmasked.
techniques.parallax-2.5d: (Family C) Manual hand-layered parallax (fore/mid/back at different rates) in After Effects/Photoshop. Deterministic. Premium hero move, hand-labor — reserve for 1-2 depth shots per episode. Do NOT use auto-depth tools (they fail on flat art).
techniques.live-still: (Family D) Subtle subject motion on a single still via Pika/Hailuo single-image mode (no end frame). Low risk — one input, no correspondence problem. Faceless figures forgive it. Keep motion micro.
techniques.morph: Scene transform A->B via Pika 2.5 start+end frame. High risk unless B is edited from A (shared base) and shapes are large/flat.
techniques.cut: Hard cut in NLE. No generation.
techniques.match-cut: Hard cut where motion/composition continues across the seam (e.g. continuing push). NLE.
techniques.cross-dissolve: Short dissolve in NLE, used for match-on-pattern or cross-register seams.

blacklist.auto-depth-2.5d: (Family E) LeiaPix/Immersity/CapCut '3D photo'. Monocular depth estimation is trained to IGNORE flat media — produces near-flat or arbitrary parallax on constructivist art. Do not use.
blacklist.ai-3d-camera: (Family F) AI orbit/fly-through that hallucinates geometry (Stability Virtual Camera, Kling/Runway camera-control on one image). No valid 3D to recover from flat art -> color blocks melt. Do not use.

motion_breakdown.note: Ep1 drops morphs: all motion is single-still (live-still via Hailuo i2v, or ken-burns rendered locally). Treatment is documentary finish (color preserved); duotone reserved as an optional accent on dark beats. aigen-02b + 04b retired.

summary.note: Ep1 defers morphs entirely (see project/CHAINED_STILL_LESSONS.md). The former morph seams became 4 cross-dissolve + 1 cut; former morph-endpoint stills became ken-burns (landscapes) or live-still (figure scenes). Vocabulary: ken-burns (local), live-still (Hailuo single-image), and NLE cut/dissolve seams.

treatment_model.default: documentary (grain + halation + vignette, no color remap)
treatment_model.doctrine: treatment = finish, not recolor; stills are generated on-palette so the duotone is reserved for deliberately bleak beats
